```{python}
import pandas as pd
from IPython.display import display, Markdown
from IPython.display import Image as DisplayImage
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

df = pd.read_csv("data.csv")
numeric = df.select_dtypes(include="number")
time_columns = [c for c in df.columns if any(token in c.lower() for token in ("date", "time", "year", "period"))]
display(Markdown(f"<div class='summary-grid'><div class='summary-card'><span class='label'>Rows</span><span class='value'>{len(df):,}</span></div><div class='summary-card'><span class='label'>Columns</span><span class='value'>{len(df.columns)}</span></div><div class='summary-card'><span class='label'>Numeric measures</span><span class='value'>{len(numeric)}</span></div></div>\n\n**Input:** `{SOURCE_FILENAME}`"))

def automatic_chart(frame, measures, time_like):
    plt.close("all")
    fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(9, 4.8))
    text_columns = [c for c in frame.columns if c not in measures and c not in time_like]
    if time_like and measures:
        raw_time = frame[time_like[0]].astype(str) if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(frame[time_like[0]]) else frame[time_like[0]]
        parsed = pd.to_datetime(raw_time, format="%Y" if pd.api.types.is_numeric_dtype(frame[time_like[0]]) else None, errors="coerce")
        plot = frame.assign(_time=parsed).dropna(subset=["_time"])
        if len(plot) >= 2:
            grouped = plot.groupby("_time")[measures[0]].sum().sort_index()
            ax.plot(grouped.index, grouped.values, marker="o", color="#245b8a")
            ax.set_title(f"{measures[0]} over time")
            ax.set_xlabel(time_like[0]); ax.set_ylabel(measures[0])
        else:
            return None
    elif text_columns and measures:
        grouped = frame.groupby(text_columns[0])[measures[0]].sum().nlargest(12).sort_values()
        grouped.plot.barh(ax=ax, color="#245b8a")
        ax.set_title(f"{measures[0]} by {text_columns[0]}"); ax.set_xlabel(measures[0])
    elif len(measures) >= 2:
        ax.scatter(frame[measures[0]], frame[measures[1]], color="#245b8a", alpha=.8)
        ax.set_title(f"{measures[1]} compared with {measures[0]}")
        ax.set_xlabel(measures[0]); ax.set_ylabel(measures[1])
    elif measures:
        ax.hist(frame[measures[0]].dropna(), bins=min(12, max(4, frame[measures[0]].nunique())), color="#245b8a")
        ax.set_title(f"Distribution of {measures[0]}"); ax.set_xlabel(measures[0]); ax.set_ylabel("Rows")
    elif text_columns:
        frame[text_columns[0]].value_counts().head(12).sort_values().plot.barh(ax=ax, color="#245b8a")
        ax.set_title(f"Most common {text_columns[0]} values"); ax.set_xlabel("Rows")
    else:
        return None
    fig.tight_layout(); fig.savefig("automatic_chart.png", dpi=150, bbox_inches="tight")
    display(DisplayImage(filename="automatic_chart.png"))
    plt.close(fig)
```
```

## Public-health view

This report gives a concise overview of the uploaded table. It highlights the size of the dataset, missing values, numeric ranges, important categories, and any visible time pattern.

## Automatic visual summary

```{python}
automatic_chart(df, list(numeric.columns), time_columns)
```

## What is in the file?

```{python}
quality = pd.DataFrame({
    "field": df.columns,
    "data type": [str(df[c].dtype) for c in df.columns],
    "missing values": [int(df[c].isna().sum()) for c in df.columns],
    "different values": [int(df[c].nunique(dropna=True)) for c in df.columns],
})
display(quality)
```

## Main numeric findings

```{python}
if numeric.empty:
    display(Markdown("No numeric measures were detected in this table."))
else:
    findings = numeric.agg(["count", "mean", "min", "max"]).transpose().round(2)
    display(findings)
```

## Time pattern

```{python}
if not time_columns:
    display(Markdown("No time field was detected, so this is presented as a snapshot."))
else:
    display(Markdown("Time-like field(s): " + ", ".join(f"`{c}`" for c in time_columns)))
    for column in time_columns:
        parsed = pd.to_datetime(df[column], errors="coerce")
        if parsed.notna().mean() >= 0.8:
            display(df.assign(_time=parsed).groupby("_time")[list(numeric.columns)].sum().tail(20) if not numeric.empty else df[column].value_counts().head(20))
```

## Important limitation

This is an automatic descriptive report. It does not establish disease thresholds, risk, causation, or public-health recommendations. Interpret the results using the source context and data-quality information.
